sections.content: is means 'also / too', but it never opens the sentence the way English 'also' can. It attaches right after the word it's adding to the list: A tanulás is fontos. puts is straight after tanulás, the word being emphasised.
If you're translating from English and your instinct is to start the sentence with 'also', stop — find the word being added and slide is in right after it instead.
